headlines.title: New York reports first measles death in more than 30 years
headlines.description: So far this year, the state has reported 178 measles cases.

headlines.title: Spotlight on Men’s Health: Plunges, Testosterone Therapy, More
headlines.description: When it comes to men’s health, keeping up with recommendations amid evolving science and changing trends can be challenging. Board-certified surgeon Dr. Cedrek McFadden joins TODAY to help separate evidence from misinformation on everything from cold plunges to testosterone therapy.

headlines.title: Rebecca Gayheart Opens Up About Eric Dane’s Life and Legacy
headlines.description: Rebecca Gayheart Dane sits down for her first broadcast interview since Eric Dane's death, opening up to Maria Shriver about the memoir he penned in the last year of his life, the couple's relationship and her journey with grief.

headlines.title: NBC News producer shares personal journey battling Alzheimer’s
headlines.description: Senior Coordinating Producer Sue Kroll travels the world covering the news, but tonight she shares her own story about her battle to fend off Alzheimer’s and the steps she’s taking to avoid the brutal disease. NBC News’ Senior National Correspondent Kate Snow reports Sue’s story.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Murphy hospitalized after suffering stroke
headlines.description: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., is recovering after having a stroke on Saturday. According to his chief of staff, Murphy started experiencing numbness in his arm while at his son's hockey game. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar explains what causes strokes, typical warning signs and treatment.

headlines.title: Runner, 24, Dies of Rhabdomyolysis at NYC Marathon. What It Is and How to Spot the Signs
headlines.description: Rachel Apa, a 24-year-old, died while running the New York City Marathon on Nov. 1. Her father spoke to NBC News about the condition that led to her death.

headlines.description: The 2026-2027 flu season is starting early, fueled by an H1N1 strain with a new mutation. Here’s where flu activity is surging and how to protect yourself.

headlines.description: Rebecca Gayheart spoke with TODAY about Eric Dane’s final week at the hospital. Ahead the release of Dane’s posthumous memoir, she details the moments before his death.
